question:
(i) Write the condition for constructive interference in terms of phase difference.
(ii) Write the condition for destructive interference in terms of phase difference.

options.D:
(i) Constructive interference occurs for $\phi=2n\pi$.
(ii) Destructive interference occurs for $\phi=(2n+1)\pi$.
